question.text: A tuning fork <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> of unknown frequency produces <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>beats</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> with a fork of known frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>340</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi></math>. When fork <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> is filed, the beat frequency decreases to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>beats</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. What is the frequency of fork <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> ?

solution.text:
Initially beat frequency =5 Hz

so, ρA=340±5=345 Hz, or 335 Hz 

after filing frequency increases slightly so, new value of frequency of A>ρA

Now, beat frequency =2 Hz

⇒ new ρA=340±2=342 Hz, or 338 Hz

hence, original frequency of A is ρA=335 Hz
